app.reason: text-transform: uppercase and tracking apply only under :lang() for cased scripts. Fixed heights clip tall scripts at segmented_control.css:17 (28px), status_bar.css:4 (36px), language_dropdown.css:10 (36px) and folder_row.css:4 (36px) (Phase 73 D-21 #9); v5.1 changes them to min-height.

The accent is set at runtime from the OS (ACCENT_COLOR_FALLBACK at src/domain/accent_color.ts:4 is only the Linux fallback), so the contrast test covers the fallback accent only. User-chosen system accents such as yellow and graphite can fall below 3:1 against a ground and cannot be proven statically; no ratio is quoted for them because no accent hex is named to measure (D-07).

The fallback accent ring directly on a raised Tide surface measures 2.86:1, below the 3:1 of WCAG 2.2 SC 1.4.11; on the Deep Teal ground it measures 3.63:1. v5.1 therefore offsets the dark ring 2 px onto the Deep Teal ground and never draws it directly on Tide; 74-04's proposed set checks the ground-adjacent pair. This is a spec value, not a sealed contrast-gap entry, because today's focus pairs all pass.

The reveal button has no ring rule of its own: its :focus-visible rule only raises opacity to 1 (file_table.css:161-164), unlike the other focusable controls in styles/, which draw the 2px accent outline. v5.1 adds the same ring so the reveal button's focus indicator is the specified one (SC 2.4.7 Focus Visible).
The ring uses the platform accent token, set at runtime from systemPreferences.getAccentColor() (D-04); it is the same colour as ::selection and the toggle-on track.
Forced-colors (Windows High Contrast) mode removes box-shadow, so a ring built from it disappears for the people who need it most; an outline is kept and recoloured.
D-12: a free-standing control (button, toggle, segmented control, link) keeps its ring 2 px outside, as every focus-visible rule in styles/ does today (outline-offset: 2px).

R-09: an outset ring on a full-width row inside .file-table__body (overflow-y: auto, file_table.css:57-59) is clipped on the left, right and first-row top; only the bottom edge draws. .file-table__row already declares outline-offset: -2px (file_table.css:70) and its :focus-visible rule overrides it to +2px at :83; menu items clip the same way.
